name: A.P. Møller - Mærsk A/S
summary: A.P. Møller - Mærsk A/S functions as a comprehensive global provider of integrated transport and logistics solutions. The company's operations are segmented across several key areas: Its Ocean division oversees worldwide containerized freight transportation, encompassing critical services such as demurrage, detention, terminal handling, documentation, container services, storage, and transshipment. This segment also facilitates the sale of bunker oil and operates under well-known brands like Maersk Line, Safmarine, Sealand – A Maersk Company, Hamburg Süd, and APM Terminal. The Logistics & Services segment offers a broad spectrum of solutions including sea and air freight forwarding, sophisticated supply chain management, specialized cold chain logistics, and customs brokerage. Terminals & Towage focuses on gateway terminal activities, alongside providing offshore towage, salvage, and various related marine support services, primarily through its APM Terminals brand. Finally, the Manufacturing & Others segment is responsible for the production of reefer containers, anchor handling tug supply vessels, and subsea support vessels. It also delivers essential training services for the maritime, oil and gas, offshore wind, and crane industries. The company was founded in 1904 and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.
